MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. 1/4

4. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 37
   D. 36

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 17
   C. 34
   D. 66

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

7. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 17
   D. 8

8. Solve for x: x + 9 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 7
   C. 15
   D. 6

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

11. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

13. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 31
   C. 41
   D. 43

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

15. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

16. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 50
   C. 11
   D. 100

17. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

18. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 42
   C. 30
   D. 21

21. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

22. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 48
   C. 49
   D. 2

23. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

24. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
